title: MoreSkinPacks
description: More skin packs for Bedrock Skins mod
body:
### Contains 5 skin packs for the Bedrock Skins mod:
- Earth Skin (contains 1 exclusive skin "Earth")
- Holiday Skin Pack 2015 (9 pcs*)
- Norse Mythology Bonus Skins (An addition to the Norse Mythology Mash-Up, 4 pcs)
- The Traveling Trader (by Jigarbov Productions, 4 pcs)
- Winter Wonders Skin Pack (partly: Furtive Fir Tree + Snowcapped modified)

### Note:
"Holiday Skin Pack 2015" is a remake of "Festive Skin Pack" (2012).
Initially, the pack contained 9 new skins and 6 old ones, but renamed. Later, the remaining 18 from the old pack were added, resulting in 9 new skins and 24 from the previous pack.
So this version contains only 9 new skins from this pack, while the remaining 24 (including 6 renamed ones, but with original names) can be found in other assemblies for the Bedrock Skins mod.
Also note the vanilla error: despite the marketplace description stating that 35 skins are included, the skin pack only contains 33 skins.
